name: osf-cli-go
description: Read-only MCP tools for Open Science Framework workflows and public Zenodo discovery.
long_description: OSF CLI Go exposes read-only Model Context Protocol tools for OSF accounts, projects, components, files, preprints, and DOI resolution, plus public Zenodo records, files, provider capabilities, and OAI-PMH metadata harvesting.

tools.name: osf_whoami
tools.description: Return the authenticated OSF user profile.

tools.name: osf_projects_list
tools.description: List projects owned by the authenticated OSF user.

tools.name: osf_project_get
tools.description: Get an OSF project or component by id or URL.

tools.name: osf_components_list
tools.description: List immediate child components for an OSF project or component.

tools.name: osf_files_list
tools.description: List OSF Storage files and folders.

tools.name: osf_file_versions_list
tools.description: List versions for an OSF Storage file.

tools.name: osf_addons_list
tools.description: List configured storage add-ons for an OSF node.

tools.name: osf_wikis_list
tools.description: List wiki pages linked to an OSF node.

tools.name: osf_comments_list
tools.description: List comments linked to an OSF node.

tools.name: osf_logs_list
tools.description: List audit logs linked to an OSF node.

tools.name: osf_identifiers_list
tools.description: List identifiers linked to an OSF node.

tools.name: osf_contributors_list
tools.description: List contributors for an OSF project or component.

tools.name: osf_search
tools.description: Search public and authenticated OSF content.

tools.name: osf_preprints_list
tools.description: List OSF preprints, optionally filtered by provider.

tools.name: osf_preprints_search
tools.description: Search OSF preprints by title, optionally filtered by provider.

tools.name: osf_doi_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a DOI to an OSF web resource without downloading or writing data.

tools.name: zenodo_oai_records_list
tools.description: List one public Zenodo OAI-PMH record page and its continuation.

tools.name: zenodo_oai_sets_list
tools.description: List public Zenodo OAI-PMH sets.

tools.name: zenodo_oai_formats_list
tools.description: List public Zenodo OAI-PMH metadata formats.

tools.name: repository_capabilities_get
tools.description: Return the reviewed OSF or Zenodo provider capability contract.

tools.name: zenodo_records_search
tools.description: Search public published Zenodo records.

tools.name: zenodo_record_get
tools.description: Inspect a public published Zenodo record.

tools.name: zenodo_files_list
tools.description: List files attached to a public published Zenodo record.

osf_token.title: OSF personal access token
osf_token.description: Preferred OSF authentication token. Create one at https://osf.io/settings/tokens/.

osf_username.title: OSF username
osf_username.description: Optional fallback username when no OSF token is provided.

osf_password.title: OSF password
osf_password.description: Optional fallback password when no OSF token is provided.
